messages:
elaine_pm: FYI ACME reported a perf/regression curve with CUDA 12.2 drivers on our marketplace image this morning. They see 18-25% token latency increase on long-context r1 workloads. Can we triage and agree a partner-facing plan? :eyes:
sam_eng: ack. do we have repro logs or a focused test-case?
kofi_partner: we repro'd locally on their cluster, using our standard perf harness. attaching notes in the ticket. they saw it only when the kernel-config had 'nobezier' (vendor-specific), which feels suspicious.
jenna_sre: @sam_eng can you try the lightweight repro on staging? if it's a kernel/driver regression, we need to decide rollback vs. workaround asap.
sam_eng: running now. quick repro command:```bash
./perf_harness --model gpt-small --seq 2048 --batch 1 --iters 100 --driver /opt/nvidia/driver-525.85
```
cheng_infra: fyi infra trace shows higher NVML mem copies and a stall at the copy kernel on 12.2. suspected kernel change in memcpy path.
mark_rel: if this is a driver binary issue we should prepare a partner communication and a rollback artifact. timeline?
kofi_partner: partner asked for ETA within 4 hours — they're blocking a customer demo tonight.
sam_eng: initial staging run shows same 20% tail latency bump. capturing perf traces now. will try a 525.60 rollback build to confirm.
jenna_sre: if rollback reproduces perf, we should gate the marketplace image and offer pinned driver option. also prepare release note wording.
elaine_pm: agreed. can someone draft the partner-facing note (short, what we observed, mitigation steps, ETA to fix)? keep it crisp.
mark_rel: I'll draft a short note and loop in legal/security for the customer impact blurbs.
sam_eng: verified: 525.60 drop brings perf back in staging. so regression introduced between 525.60 -> 525.85. log snippet:```text
[trace] kernel memcpy_async: avg 0.12ms -> 0.38ms
[trace] nvml_copy: stall 0 -> 45ms
```
cheng_infra: filing infra bug with kernel traces. also adding a hotfix lane to our CI that pins driver to 525.60 for marketplace images until we have a signed driver from partner.
deploy-bot: scheduled rollback canary for marketplace-image:mar-rc -> marketplace-image:stable at 4447901000 (manual approval required).
elaine_pm: thanks team. next steps: 1) mark marketplace image as pinned to 525.60 and add note in console; 2) partner comms drafted by @mark_rel in 1h; 3) infra ticket created by @cheng_infra; 4) eng root cause + hotfix plan by @sam_eng by EOD. I'll own partner sync during the demo window.
kofi_partner: thanks all — I'll brief ACME and ask them to pause demos until we push the pinned image.
jenna_sre: adding runbook snippet to incident thread for oncall:```text
If partner reports perf regression after driver upgrade:
1) confirm driver version and kernel config
2) run quick repro (perf_harness cmd) on staging
3) if rollback resolves, pin marketplace image and notify partner
4) escalate to infra for kernel traces
```
sam_eng: adding perf traces and diffs to the ticket now. will open PR to add driver pin flag to image builder.
mark_rel: partner-ready note (draft): "We observed a driver regression affecting token latencies on CUDA 12.2+ in specific kernel configs. We are temporarily pinning marketplace images to driver 525.60 and will coordinate a verified driver upgrade with ACME. Expected next update in 2-4 hours."
elaine_pm: perfect. please add a short 'what we tried' bullet and the exact repro command. then I'll send.
cheng_infra: ticket: INFRA-7241 created with traces and kernel symbols. linking to partner ticket.
elaine_pm: closing loop — thanks everyone, great quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
